name.en: Fake car dealer website with low prices and nationwide delivery

how.en: You find a website selling cars at good prices, with an Australian address, phone number and ABN, lots of stock and nationwide delivery. Some copy a real dealer, using photos of cars it has already sold. Limited-time offers push you to act, and professional-looking invoices and contracts make the bank transfer feel normal. The car never arrives.

text.en: You find a car website with an Australian address, ABN and low prices.
Limited-time offers push you to decide quickly.
They send a professional-looking invoice and contract.
You pay by bank transfer and the car never arrives.
Thanks for your enquiry on the 2021 Toyota RAV4. The sale price of $24,900 is only held until Friday. Please find your invoice attached; delivery Australia-wide once the bank transfer clears.
